sql: SELECT 'setting' AS src, s.id::text AS id, c.name, l.n, l.line FROM ai_agent_settings s JOIN companies c ON c.id = s.company_id, LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(s.extra_instructions, E'\n')) WITH ORDINALITY AS l(line, n) WHERE c.name ILIKE '%castelo%' AND l.line ILIKE '%degust%' UNION ALL SELECT 'note', o.id::text, c.name, 0, o.text FROM ai_owner_notes o JOIN companies c ON c.id = o.company_id WHERE c.name ILIKE '%castelo%' AND o.text ILIKE '%degust%'
